newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank drains 5 bln Skr from the market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank drains 5 bln Skr from the market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it drained five billion crowns ($659.1 million) from the market in its weekly reverse repurchase operation.
The reverse repo was set at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent and will run from March 12 to 19, replacing an operation that drained five billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 1.22 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
-- Birgitta Forsberg, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1006 ($ = 7.586 Swedish Crowns)
